_comment: Pinned third-party Python packages for the Tier A coverage study (#493).
Hermeticity here means SOURCE hermeticity — the harness only parses,
encodes and re-encodes these files, it never installs or runs them — so
the bar is: pure Python, standard library only (no C/Cython extension
modules, no generated sources), permissively licensed, and small enough to
shallow-clone. chardet was considered and REJECTED: it now ships a
hatch_build_cython.py build hook, so its tree is no longer pure Python.
Each `ref` is a commit SHA resolved from the repo's default branch on
2026-09-03 via the GitHub API, so a Tier A number is reproducible; bump it
deliberately, never to chase a number. `lib` is the subtree that is
actually studied. An unreachable pin is reported separately and is NOT
